title: Yaqub's beautiful patience

phrases.text: His sons came home at night, weeping… carrying a shirt with false blood on it.
Prophet Yaqub, peace be upon him, loved his son Yusuf dearly.
Out of jealousy, Yusuf's brothers threw him into the bottom of a well.
They told their father a wolf had eaten him.
Yaqub knew they were hiding the truth. And he said:
He complained of his grief only to Allah.
And years later, Allah reunited him with Yusuf.
Beautiful patience is never wasted. Follow for more stories from the Qur'an.

caption:
“So patience is most fitting.” 🤍
